section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing installation of side gear shaft using a plastic hammer

steps.label: (a)
steps.text: Before installing the shaft, replace the snap ring.

steps.label: (b)
steps.text: Using a plastic hammer, drive in the side gear shaft until it contacts the pinion shaft.

content.text: NOTE: As the LSD cannot be checked visually, check that the shaft is fully inserted by confirming the sound it makes when it is tapped.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of side gear shaft runout using a dial indicator

items.heading: MEASURE SIDE GEAR SHAFT RUNOUT
items.text:
Maximum runout: 0.20 mm (0.0079 in.)
If the runout is greater than the maximum, replace the side gear shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of differential assembly with jack support and carrier bolt installation

items.heading: INSTALL DIFFERENTIAL
items.text: Support the differential with a jack and install the carrier bolt.

items.heading: INSTALL DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER MOUNTING BOLT NO. 1 (See page RA-55)
items.text: Lower the differential and remove the jack.

content.component: Differential support member mounting bolt No. 1

items.heading: CONNECT PROPELLER SHAFT FLANGE FROM COMPANION FLANGE

content.description: Cross-section diagram of differential showing drain plug location and internal components

items.heading: INSTALL DRAIN PLUG AND FILL DIFFERENTIAL WITH GEAR OIL
items.text:
Hypoid gear oil: w/LSD use LSD oil only
SAE 90 above — 18°C (0°F)
SAE 80W or 80W — 90
at temperature below — 18°C (0°F)
Capacity: 1.2 liters (1.3 US qts, 1.1 Imp. qts)
Install a filler plug.
